response.sql: WITH per_rating AS (SELECT rating, AVG(rental_rate / rental_duration) AS avg_rate_per_day, COUNT(*) AS films FROM film WHERE rental_duration > 5 GROUP BY rating), benchmark AS (SELECT AVG(avg_rate_per_day) AS bench FROM per_rating) SELECT p.rating, p.avg_rate_per_day, p.films, p.avg_rate_per_day / b.bench AS ratio_to_benchmark FROM per_rating p CROSS JOIN benchmark b WHERE b.bench IS NOT NULL;
